unlisted_practices: Integrating a PrEP patient navigator alongside an EHR prediction model to link jail-released individuals to community care
Using qualitative stakeholder interviews and the EPIS framework to adapt an implementation strategy before deploying a predictive model

screen.reason: This is a study protocol describing a type 3 hybrid implementation-effectiveness trial testing a multicomponent strategy that incorporates an EHR-based HIV risk prediction model and patient navigator in actual jail clinical operations.

primary.practice: EHR-based risk prediction integrated with patient navigation and shared decision-making
